units.source_text: 且说三公主那天傍晚忽然腹痛起来，懂事的侍女知道要分娩了，

en.t: Now, that evening, the Third Princess suddenly began to have pains in her abdomen, and the experienced ladies in waiting knew that she was about to give birth,

units.source_text: 大家都很慌张，连忙派人去通报源氏。

en.t: everyone was thrown into a panic and hurriedly sent someone to inform Genji.

units.source_text: 源氏也很惊惶，立刻回来看视。

en.t: Genji too was greatly alarmed and came back at once to see how she was.

units.source_text: 但他心中想道：“真可惜了！

en.t: But in his heart he thought, How unfortunate this is!

units.source_text: 如果没有那种嫌疑，此事何等可庆，何等可喜啊！”

en.t: If only there were no such suspicion, how worthy of celebration and how joyful this event would be!

units.source_text: 然而他在人前绝不泄露心事，立刻召请高僧来举行安产祈祷。

en.t: Yet before others he did not reveal his feelings at all, and immediately summoned eminent monks to perform prayers for a safe delivery.

units.source_text: 邸内本来天天有许多法师在做功德，就在僧众中选择道行高深之人，叫他们都来参与。

en.t: Since many priests were already performing meritorious rites in the residence every day, he chose those of deepest spiritual practice from among them and had them all take part.

units.source_text: 三公主痛苦了一夜，第二天日出时分就临盆了。

en.t: The Third Princess suffered through the night, and at sunrise the next day she gave birth.

units.source_text: 源氏闻知新生的是个男儿，心中想道：“因有那件秘密事情，如果不巧，生下来相貌就肖似那人，这才糟呢。

en.t: When Genji learned that the newborn child was a boy, he thought to himself, Because of that secret matter, if by some misfortune the child is born looking like that man, it will be disastrous.

units.source_text: 倘是一个女儿，还可设法掩饰，并且看见的人也不会多，倒可安心。”

en.t: If it were a daughter, I could still find some way to conceal things, and not many people would see her, so I could be more at ease.

units.source_text: 既而又想：“有这种嫌疑的孩子，是个男的，教养便当些，也是好的。

en.t: After a while he thought again, For a child burdened with this kind of suspicion, being a boy may make his upbringing more manageable, and that too is good.

units.source_text: 不过事情真也奇怪：我一生犯了许多可怕的罪孽，这大约是报应吧。

en.t: Still, the whole affair is truly strange: in my life I have committed many dreadful sins, and this is probably retribution.

units.source_text: 在现世就受了这意外的惩罚，到了后世，罪障可以减轻些了吧。”

en.t: Since I have received this unexpected punishment in this present life, perhaps the burden of my sins will be somewhat lighter in the life to come.

units.source_text: 不知内情的人，都以为这位小公子出于高贵公主之腹，又是晚年所得之子，源氏大人一定异常宝爱，因此特别用心服侍。

en.t: Those who did not know the truth all assumed that this young prince, born from the womb of a noble princess and also a child granted to Genji in his later years, must be especially treasured by him, and so they served with particular care.

units.source_text: 产室中就举行非常隆重盛大的仪式。

en.t: In the birth chamber, extremely solemn and splendid ceremonies were held.

units.source_text: 六条院诸夫人送来种种精美的产汤。

en.t: The ladies of Rokujo-in sent all kinds of exquisite first bath offerings for the child.

units.source_text: 连世俗例行的木片盒、叠层方木盘和高脚杯，也都各人别出心裁，比赛巧妙。

en.t: Even the customary wooden boxes, stacked square trays, and stemmed cups were each made with individual ingenuity, as everyone competed in skill and refinement.
